description: PostgreSQL. Put *.sql / *.sh seed files in <app dir>/initdb; they run on first init only. Flyway migrations are read from the migrations directory.

name.help: Applied only when the data volume is first created; to change it later run SQL (ALTER ROLE/DATABASE) or `gantry destroy` the app.

user.help: Applied only when the data volume is first created; to change it later run SQL (ALTER ROLE/DATABASE) or `gantry destroy` the app.

password.help: Applied only when the data volume is first created; to change it later run SQL (ALTER ROLE/DATABASE) or `gantry destroy` the app.

migrations.help: Directory of Flyway migrations (V1__init.sql, ...). Point it at your service's own migration folder.

migrate_on_up.help: Run pending Flyway migrations after every `up`.
